comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom (AVGO) disclose the issuance of large amounts of senior unsecured notes as part of their debt management strategy, though the timing and structure differ significantly. AMD issued $1.0 billion in Notes in June 2022 to fund general corporate purposes, whereas Broadcom issued $10 billion in senior unsecured notes in 2024 ($5 billion in July and $5 billion in October), likely supporting recent acquisitions or refinancing activities. While AMD's notes are governed by a single 2022 indenture with fixed rates of 3.924% and 4.393%, Broadcom's 2024 issuance represents a more recent and substantial capital raise event within the fiscal year.
